## featherdrop v2.1.0

A visual refresh — the same featherdrop, now noticeably more elegant.

## Changed

- **Floating glass UI.** The upload page is now a frosted-glass window that
  floats over a soft gold/violet ambient background. The drop zone sits inside
  it as a recessed glass well that lights up gold when you drag a file over it.
- **Feather front and centre.** The logo crowns the top of the drop zone, and
  the header logo + wordmark are larger.
- **Sharper copy.** The subtitle now reads *"Encrypted, and gone when it
  expires."* — localised across all 26 languages — and a redundant footer line
  was removed.

No functional changes; encryption, languages, and sharing behave exactly as in
2.0.1.
